cost_model.note: Serial component estimate with models already loaded. Peak memory is reported as the largest independently measured fusion peak and is not additive.

selection.procedure: Fix K=5 and margin=1.5. For every subset containing visible, require every development evaluator gain to be at least -0.0005 AP50. Among feasible subsets, take those within 0.00001 of the largest mean gain, then choose the fewest detector forwards and lowest measured component cost.
